VeriFactu (AEAT)
top of page 1, centred
A4 portrait, 210 x 297 mm (not to scale inside)
QR tributario:
VERI*FACTU
Total
30 to 40 mm, level M, 2 mm quiet zone minimum
caption above, legend below, first page only
TicketBAI (Basque Country)
bottom of the invoice, identifier above
A4 portrait, 210 x 297 mm (not to scale inside)
Total
TBAI-NIF-DDMMYY-signature-CRC
30 to 40 mm, level M, UTF-8, 6 mm recommended border
identifier on one line, QR directly below it
Payment codes (EPC, Swiss)
payment block at the foot of the page
A4 portrait, 210 x 297 mm (not to scale inside)
Total
detachable payment part (Swiss) or payment box (EPC)
Payment part
Account / Payable to
Swiss: 46 x 46 mm with a 7 x 7 mm cross, level M
EPC: level M, payload up to 331 bytes
The QR symbols are drawn schematically; they do not encode a real invoice. Rules checked against the sources as of 2026-10-09.
Do not mix up the codes: the tax QR is always the first QR code on the invoice, and a payment QR never replaces it.
